formula: a_j=log(H_j/H_(j-1)); b_j=log(L_j/L_(j-1)); g_j=median(a_j,b_j,0). Same-sign boundary changes retain the smaller common displacement; opposed changes yield0. limitations: Median boundary motion is neither actual support ownership nor fillability. Neutralizes inside as well as outside bars; can omit genuine strong outside-day reversal, direction hidden in narrowing intervals, and new V starts. Same .9/21 memory can retain old strength and delay reversal. Open/close progression and continuation profit are not guaranteed.
decision: First fixed-case study only. Do not tune zero cutoff/window/weights or add branch after seeing cases. A useful separation is required before any larger coverage or economic study, not proven by mathematical novelty.
